sloka: ततः कृत्वा महानादम् सा वै लङ्का भयावहम् ।तलेन वानरश्रेष्ठम् ताडयामास वेगिता ॥५-३-३८॥
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtvā mahānādam sā vai laṅkā bhayāvaham ।talena vānaraśreṣṭham tāḍayāmāsa vegitā ॥5-3-38॥

translations.english: Then the ogress of Lanka made a loud and frightening sound and struck the most powerful vanara with the palm of her hand.
